metadata.description: Claude has friends. On the calls that matter, it asks AIs from other families — Gemini, an isolated second Claude, optionally GPT — who catch the blind spots Claude can't see from the inside. Three styles, auto-picked by what you type. CLI-only, English-only docs.

plugins.name: claude-friends
plugins.description: Claude asks AIs from other families before the calls that matter — Gemini (different training), an isolated second Claude with no memory of your conversation, optionally GPT. Three styles picked from what you type: one friend for a gut-check, the whole table for high-stakes, a multi-round round-table for choosing between paths. Reviewers are input, never a vote — you still decide. CLI only, no MCP.
